YURI_OVERLIMIT.title: Over Limit
YURI_OVERLIMIT.description:
Gain 2 Over Limit whenever you play a card and additional Over Limit equal to Combo gained. 
Gain 3 Over Limit at the start of your turn. 

When Over Limit reaches 100, gain [gold]Over Limit[/gold] buff and apply all [blue]Combo[/blue] bonuses regardless of Combo Count for 2 turns.
YURI_COMBO.title: Combo
YURI_COMBO.description: Represents the total number of hits chained during combat. Attacks increase Combo based on their hit count. Higher
YURI_BASE_ARTE.title: Base Arte
YURI_BASE_ARTE.description: Base Artes boost the next Arcane Arte and contribute their listed Combo count.
YURI_ARCANE_ARTE.title: Arcane Arte
YURI_ARCANE_ARTE.description: Arcane Artes contribute their listed Combo count and apply additional effects if played after a Base Arte.
